title: RuneScape Dragonwilds Update v1.0.1.3 to v1.0.1.0 All Patch Notes, Boss Fixes & New Features!
author: NRS NEO
description:
RuneScape: Dragonwilds has received several updates bringing important bug fixes, combat improvements, gameplay changes, and stability fixes! ⚔️🌲

In this video, we cover all the major changes from v1.0.1.3 back to v1.0.1.0, including the latest hotfixes and the previous update.

Here's what we're covering:

✅ Kuldra Boss Fixes and encounter improvements
✅ Commander Zilyana platform issues and raid fixes
✅ Air Magic Staff damage and attack combo fixes
✅ Dragon Scimitar Jump Attack improvements
✅ Runecrafting and equipment durability fixes
✅ Xbox Multiplayer and dedicated server stability improvements
✅ New Combat Abilities, including Jump Attack and ranged special attacks
✅ Inventory Improvements, new equipment slots, and quality of life changes
✅ Save Recovery Fixes, quest improvements, and more!

Whether you're exploring Ashenfall, fighting bosses, crafting gear, or playing with friends, these updates bring plenty of changes worth knowing about.

Watch until the end for a look back at the previous update and how it helped address save issues and multiplayer stability.

💬 Which fix or new feature are you most excited about?
